worktree.lint: bash -lc 'set -a; . .envs/.postgres; . .envs/.django; set +a; POSTGRES_HOST=localhost uv run ruff check "$@"' -- <paths>
worktree.tests: bash -lc 'export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/gnu-sed/libexec/gnubin:$PATH"; set -a; . .envs/.postgres; . .envs/.django; set +a; export POSTGRES_HOST=localhost POSTGRES_DB="${POSTGRES_DB}_$(printf %s "${FORGE_GATE_RUN_ID:-$(basename "$PWD")}" | tr -c "a-zA-Z0-9" _ | cut -c1-40)" DJANGO_REDIS_URL="${DJANGO_REDIS_URL//redis:6379/localhost:6379}"; [ -z "${CELERY_BROKER_URL:-}" ] || export CELERY_BROKER_URL="${CELERY_BROKER_URL//redis:6379/localhost:6379}"; uv run --group sandbox pytest "$@" --create-db' -- <paths>
worktree.migrations: bash -lc 'set -a; . .envs/.postgres; . .envs/.django; set +a; POSTGRES_HOST=localhost uv run python manage.py makemigrations --dry-run --no-input --check'
